units.source_text: K出生在真宗寺，但从中学时代起，他的观念就与生父所信奉的教义相去甚远。

en.t: K was born at a Shinshu temple, but from his middle school years his views were far removed from the doctrine his birth father believed in.

units.source_text: 我不大懂得教义上的区别，自知没有资格这样说，

en.t: I do not really understand the doctrinal differences, and I know I am not qualified to speak this way,

units.source_text: 我只是从男女情爱的角度这样判断他的。

en.t: I judged him only from the standpoint of love between men and women.

units.source_text: K很早就喜欢把‘精进’这个词挂在嘴上，

en.t: From early on, K liked to keep the word devotion on his lips,

units.source_text: 所以我一直以为这个词也包含着禁欲的意思。

en.t: so I had always thought that the word also included the meaning of abstinence.

units.source_text: 但是后来问了他这个词的真正意义，才知道其含意比禁欲更为严苛，我惊讶万分。

en.t: But later, when I asked him the true meaning of the word, I learned that it was harsher than abstinence, and I was deeply astonished.

units.source_text: 为了道义值得牺牲一切，乃是K的第一信条，

en.t: K's first article of faith was that everything was worth sacrificing for the sake of moral duty,

units.source_text: 因此，姑且不论摄欲或禁欲，即便是脱离了情欲的恋爱也是有碍修道的。

en.t: so, quite apart from moderation or abstinence, even a love detached from desire was an obstacle to spiritual discipline.

units.source_text: 他靠打工养活自己的那段时间，我常常听他对我发表这种见解，

en.t: During the time when he supported himself by working, I often heard him express this view to me,

units.source_text: 那时我已经爱上了小姐，势必对他的论点予以反驳。

en.t: and by then I had already fallen in love with the young lady, so I was bound to argue against his position.

units.source_text: 我一表示反对，他就露出怜悯的神情。

en.t: As soon as I voiced opposition, he showed a pitying expression.

units.source_text: 他那神情中，轻蔑的成分更多于同情。

en.t: In that expression there was more contempt than sympathy.
